body:
This version uses the 2025-2026 tables. Under the 2026-2027 guidelines
many holdover times are shorter, and none are longer — so this version
can show more time than the current guidelines allow.

Update before your next departure.
title: Holdover Times Out of Date

body: On some devices Nearby Weather always failed, saying the weather service was unavailable. The real cause was ours: the app asked for weather near you in a way the service could not read, and whether it happened depended on your exact location. Version 2.4.1 fixes it. Updating is recommended, not required — Search Other Stations and manual entry were never affected.
title: Nearby Weather fix in 2.4.1
